request: a dark doom fusion in Darbari, key of D, teental, 120 bpm

seed_riff.reasoning: The riff anchors the Darbari tonality in the sub-octave with heavy Sa sustain, palm-muted pedal chugs, moves to komal ga, lands on vadi Re, explores mandra komal dha, and closes with a chromatic-feeling slide turnaround to sam.

phrase_plan.climax_and_sam: Surges to madhya Pa, releases into held Sa breather, dives into mandra Pa, and drives into sam Re

seed_head.idea: A brooding, oscillating Darbari mukhada landing on Re, plunging into mandra Dha-Ni-Pa before surging back to sam

energy_arc: Intro: slow, cavernous alaap exploring mandra saptak over tanpura; Mukhada 1: the doom band drops with crushing weight, stating the main theme; Manjha: dynamics pull downward into deep low Pa; Mukhada 2: explosive re-entry of the theme; Antara: soaring leap into taar Sa and komal ga; Taan: relentless gamak taan accelerating to the peak; Mukhada 3: all voices join in maximum sonic devastation; Outro: immense final Sa chord ringing into dark silence.

rhythm_section.reasoning: Arrangement plan: The key is established on the low D/Sa home root, which sustains with immense doom weight across the piece. The head (mukhada) follows a recurring chord pattern of S power 8 | g power 4 | R power 4, resolving with heavy palm-muted chugs and a 16th-note turnaround back into sam; this pattern returns identically in sections 3 and 6 using same_as: 1. In the manjha (section 2), the harmony descends into mandra darkness following S power 8 | d power 4 | P power 4, supporting the low Dha and Pa and answering with crushing power chords during the sitar's rest at beats 12-16. In the antara (section 4), the chords shift to m power 8 | P power 4 | S power 4 and the guitar climbs to octave 1 to match the sitar's ascent to taar Sa and komal ga, ringing wide under held andolan and gamak gestures. In the taan (section 5), the rhythm section locks into relentless driving half-time chugs over the home pedal progression, maintaining momentum under cascading phrases. Finally, the outro (section 7) lands squarely on a massive sustained Sa chord across the final 6 beats into deep silence.

parts.role: Establishes the crushing doom head pattern with long Sa sustain, tight 8th chugs, and a 16th-note turnaround into sam
Sinks deep into mandra register following S to d and P, answering with heavy power chords in the sitar's rest

Climbs to octave 1 with massive chords on ma and Pa supporting the sitar's taar saptak expansion
Maintains crushing half-time rhythmic drive anchored on Sa, ga, and Re underneath the long taan
Triumphant final return of mukhada with maximum doom weight
Massive final Sa power chord rings out for 6 full beats into dark silence
